review: Implemented the round-9 World Agent specification as a versioned two-round stationary observation with one energy spent each active round, actual visible/reachable natural target checks, individual one-round study, interrupt cleanup and a current-state evidence event. No stock, mastery, object or satisfaction is gifted at installation. Existing private event memory retains completion; visible target rendering highlights only its real completion event. Tests cover absent mastery, elapsed cost, save/restore, unchanged stock, no mental reward, interruptions, vanished/distant targets and resource prerequisites. The protected controller, budgets, goals and executed prefix remain unchanged.
